objective: Prove the existing T12 lane store can run a durable dispatch loop, and add only the thin pieces it lacks.
who_benefits: Every agent that gets a ticket, and the operator reading a five-line status.
why_now: Leases tonight exist only as a worktree and a branch; nothing reconciles them on wake.
allowed_environment_and_write_mode: local only; throwaway embedded Postgres; no prod connection

authoritative_refs.why_it_matters: This is the durable store; extend it, do not build a second conductor.

related_failures_and_lessons: Rehearsal 3 conductor killed after 3 of 24 with no resume
implementation_constraints: default-inert; pure functions with an injected clock
positive_and_negative_controls: five drill lines PASS; fence broken via a test double turns stale-lease and duplicate lines FAIL
expected_results: five PASS lines; receipts verify after each step; zero rows ever in done/verified/shadow_reject
lease_heartbeat_and_checkpoint: branch cc/2026-11-18-dispatch-loop-c; checkpoint lines in DISPATCH_LOOP.md
retry_budget_and_stop_conditions: 3 attempts per failing step, then diagnose and move on
handoff_and_next_action: push the branch; dispatcher schedules the reconcile check
